objective.text: Use an object-backed array cast when in-place mutation must be tracked.

difficulty.rationale: Choose an object-backed representation for a required in-place update API.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A settings model must support $model->settings["theme"] = "dark"; $model->save(); without a local-array reassignment. The JSON column must remain structured data. Which cast is intended for this interface?

options.rationale: This controls array JSON serialization behavior, not mutable offset access through an object-backed cast.
options.misconception: This controls array JSON serialization behavior, not mutable offset access through an object-backed cast.

options.rationale: A generic decoded object is not the ArrayObject offset interface requested here.
options.misconception: A generic decoded object is not the ArrayObject offset interface requested here.

options.rationale: AsArrayObject supplies a cached mutable object and integrates its state with persistence.
The primitive array cast does not make overloaded offset modification work in place.
